name: 94085 · Sunnyvale, CA
findings: ZIP 94085 (Sunnyvale) has 80 nonprofit organizations. 28 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 94085 (Sunnyvale) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
32% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 94085 (Sunnyvale) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 19 organizations here; 55% of all organizations here have no identified type.
